transcript: You keep finding mucus in your throat even when you are not sick. Try swallowing now. If something won't clear, listen. Your body is whispering. In the old medicine of China, we call this phlegm dampness. It is not a shameful illness. It is an imbalance. Often it appears when the spleen and digestion grow weak, when the river inside you slows. Think of the busy American life, late takeout, too much coffee, stress from work and screens. These nudge the stream to stall. The body is mostly water, meant to flow like a clear mountain spring. When that flow slows, water thickens and becomes cloudy. Flem dampness. Over time, this heaviness may leave you tired, foggy, craving sweets, or putting on weight without clear reason. These are signs, not fate. The river can move again. If you live in the U.S. and want simple natural steps to clear phlegm dampness, comment phlegm and I will send the next steps, practical, gentle, and made for busy American days. For educational purposes only, not medical advice.
